blocks.text: BANGA, South Cotabato — The sleepy town of Banga in South Cotabato continues to mourn the tragic deaths of three students in a campus shooting incident, with local officials and municipal employees lighting candles and offering prayers for the victims Mayor Albert Palencia led municipal officials and employees in the solemn rites held during the flag-raising ceremony on Monday. It was a show of sympathy and solidarity to the victims, their families, and the school community. Last Friday, the town was shocked by a shooting incident inside the Banga National High School that left three students dead and six others wounded. […]...
